officialSources.role: Official Jupiter documentation points to the JUP6 Swap Program IDL on Solscan.
JUP6 program page and displayed on-chain IDL; explorer observation, not a Jupiter executable-build attestation.

verifiedInterface.routeV2DecodeBoundary: The discriminator, serialized argument types/order, and ten fixed account roles are syntactically decodable from this displayed IDL. RoutePlanStepV2 contains a Swap enum, bps, and input/output indices; it does not contain the quoted routePlan swapInfo.ammKey or label. The IDL does not specify the Quantum pool/vault/oracle positions among route-dependent remaining accounts.

blockers.detail: The on-chain RoutePlanStepV2 encodes a Swap enum, bps, input_index, and output_index; it does not encode the quoted routePlan swapInfo.ammKey or label, so the Quantum variant cannot be bound to the captured quote's AMM identity from this instruction alone.

The current IDL lists the ten fixed route_v2 accounts but does not define the Quantum pool, vault, oracle, and token account positions among route-dependent remaining accounts; the APN guard cannot verify those account roles without an exact account ABI.

Solscan displays an executable JUP6 program and an IDL version at slot 449568452 (program page reports deployed slot 449280566), but neither this explorer view nor the reviewed official Jupiter sources pin executable bytes or provide a reproducible-build/source attestation tying the deployed binary to this IDL and builder.

decision.reason: route_v2 is syntactically decodable from the current JUP6 on-chain IDL, but RoutePlanStepV2 does not bind the quoted ammKey, the IDL does not define Quantum route-dependent remaining-account positions, and no deployed executable source/build attestation links the binary to this IDL. Keep JUP6 signing fail closed.
